description:
## Goal

Grow resources/twilio/ beyond the current cloud-api credentials shape so phone-agent and audio-tools twilio-voice transport can use it for real telephony.

## Scope

### Number provisioning
- CLI to purchase / list / release Twilio phone numbers
- Number-to-routine mapping (which number triggers which inbound routine)

### Inbound voice
- TwiML app provisioning (one per number or shared)
- <Connect><Stream> webhook configured to point at audio-tools twilio-voice transport endpoint
- Caller-ID allow-list enforcement at the resource boundary

### Outbound voice
- REST wrapper for placing outbound calls (number to dial + which routine to attach on connect)
- Call status webhooks for lifecycle tracking (ringing, answered, completed, failed, no-answer)

### Configuration
- Voice-related credentials live alongside existing TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID / TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
- Per-number configuration in resource.json or sibling config

## Constraints

- Keep cli/main.go thin per existing twilio resource architecture; voice-specific logic lives under cli/internal/
- Express as much as possible in resource.json per the cloud-api pattern; add Go code only where specialization is real
- Do not couple to phone-agent — this is a generic telephony surface any consumer can use
name: resource-twilio-voice-surface
title: Add voice surface to resource-twilio (TwiML, Media Streams, outbound, numbers)
